Isolated TestBroker account was created; admin real accounts + live trades left untouched (no panic, no config toggles, no ticks posted to admin bridge tokens).
critical_code_review_comments: pip_utils.base_symbol prefix strategy is order-sensitive: iteration order is (PIP_SIZE keys → SYMBOL_ALIASES → FX_MAJOR_BASES). Any future FX major added to PIP_SIZE (e.g. an FX pair with non-standard pip) would need to be removed from FX_MAJOR_BASES to avoid double-listing — low risk today but worth a TODO comment.

base_symbol uses str.startswith so 'EURUSDX' would resolve to 'EURUSD' (accepted). For plain FX bases this is safe because brokers only append suffix chars, but the function has no allow-list on suffix charset; a defensive suffix regex (e.g. r'^EURUSD([._#\-a-zA-Z0-9]{0,6})?$') would be stricter. Not urgent — tick ingestion is protected by bridge_token so no attacker vector.

scalp/permissions.py get_cached returns 'control-plane permissions stale — fail closed' both when cache is MISSING and when >120s old — worth splitting into two distinct reasons for observability (helps distinguish 'never refreshed' from 'refresh stalled').

bridge_routes.receive_ticks: get_runner is called on EVERY tick batch even after hydration — cheap (dict lookup) but the ensure_account_lease + hydration branch could log a single 'runner-hydrated' line for post-mortem forensics (currently silent).

trade_routes.live_open_trades: account_id is now included but is `t.get('account_id')` — legacy trade docs pre-account-multitenancy may have None here. Consider a Pydantic response model so frontend contract is explicit.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (fixed pre-iter44): pip_utils.base_symbol() only iterated PIP_SIZE keys + SYMBOL_ALIASES, so plain FX majors that use the DEFAULT_PIP (0.0001) — EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDCAD, etc. — were absent from the prefix table. A broker publishing 'EURUSD#' would fall through and return 'EURUSD#' unchanged. Downstream: (a) routes/bridge_routes.receive_ticks called get_runner('EURUSD#') → approved('EURUSD#') returns None → response {'status':'ignored','reason':'EURUSD# not in approved scalp universe'}; runner.counters.ticks never advanced; the /scalp/status endpoint showed Ticks 0. (b) receive_candles stored bars under intraday_candles doc symbol='EURUSD#' (orphaned), so permissions._compute reading {'symbol':'EURUSD'} always saw len(bars)<12 → returned early; the cache was never populated → get_cached returned the STALE fallback 'control-plane permissions stale — fail closed'. FIX: added FX_MAJOR_BASES tuple (24 non-JPY FX majors) and a third for-loop in base_symbol so 'EURUSD#'/'EURUSD.r'/'EURUSDm' now resolve to 'EURUSD'. Verified via 10 pytest cases including a direct MongoDB inspection that the intraday_candles doc now lives at symbol='EURUSD' with source_symbol='EURUSD#', and that runner counters.ticks advances on suffixed tick batches. Regression: USDCAD (base) + USDCAD# (suffixed) still ignored because approved() gates on APPROVED dict (only EURUSD).
